definitions.meaning: Deceit, deception, cunning, fraud, device, wile, craft

quotations.old_english: Mid hwelcum lotwrence hit deófla dýdon
quotations.english: with what deception devils did it

quotations.old_english: Philippus mid his lotwrence áliéfde ðæt heora anwaldas móston standan swá hié ǽr dydon
quotations.english: Philip, with his craftiness, allowed their powers to stand as they did before

quotations.old_english: Gif hwá mid his lotwrencum óðres mannes folgere fram him ápǽce
quotations.latin: si quis versutiis suis alius hominis pedisequam ab eo allexerit
quotations.citations: L. Ecg. P. ii. 14; Th. ii. 186, 22

Ða ðe ðisse worulde lotwrenceas cunnon

source_text: lot-wrenc, es; m. Deceit, deception, cunning, fraud, device, wile, craft :-- Lotwrænc deceptio, fraus, Wrt. Voc. ii. 138, 13. Mid hwelcum lotwrence hit deófla dýdon with what deception devils did it, Ors. 3, 3; Swt. 102, 18. Philippus mid his lotwrence áliéfde ðæt heora anwaldas móston standan swá hié ǽr dydon Philip, with his craftiness, allowed their powers to stand as they did before, 3, 7; Swt. 118, 9. Gif hwá mid his lotwrencum óðres mannes folgere fram him ápǽce si quis versutiis suis alius hominis pedisequam ab eo allexerit, L. Ecg. P. ii. 14; Th. ii. 186, 22. Ðá wearþ se mann mid deófles lotwrencum bepǽht, Homl. Th. i. 192, 11: 376, 9: Wulfst. 84, 19. For his lotwrencium, Past. 30, 1; Swt. 203, 19. Þurh ðara scuccena mislíce lotwrencas daemonum varia solertia, Bt. 36, 6; Fox 220, 14. Hé heora lotwrencas [-wrencceas, MS. B.] wiste sciens versutiam eorum, Mk. Skt. 12, 15. Ða ðe ðisse worulde lotwrenceas cunnon sapientes hujus seculi, Past. 30, 1; Swt. 203, 5: Swt. 205, 17.
